title: Quick Quenched Almond Pilaf
description: A nutty and dense dish inspired by a monsoon Brazilian cuisine featuring gherkin relish for an unexpected burst of tanginess. Perfect as a snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Pinch of freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Rinse quinoa and drain. In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa, almonds, gherkins, salt, cayenne pepper, black pepper, lemon juice, and cold water.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat, let stand covered in its own cooking liquid for 5-10 minutes. Toss gently with a fork to separate grains.
Season with salt to taste. Serve immediately.
